notes.title: 🛠️ Bug Fixes Update
notes.content:
[u]Hey Enforcers[/u],
We’re back with a fresh patch update that improves gameplay stability, polishes audio feedback, enhances controller support, and fixes several in-game issues. Thanks for all your continued feedback — here’s what’s new:
[b]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/b]
[b]Rush Gamemode:[/b] Corrected UI label — "Points to Win" now properly reads as "Respawn Lives."

[b]Vote Screen Glitch:[/b] Fixed an issue where players could vote multiple times in online mode after pressing Tab.

[b]Support Drops (Ammo / Medic / Explosives):[/b] Resolved a bug in First-Person View that caused weapons to freeze after using drops.

[b]Menu Quit Glitch (Controller): [/b]Addressed a controller input bug that caused the menu to freeze or glitch when attempting to quit.

[b]Drone Spawn:[/b] Fixed an issue where drones could occasionally spawn inside walls.

[b]Climbing into Rocks:[/b] Prevented players from getting stuck inside rocks during climbing actions.

[b]Controller Menu Navigation:[/b] Fixed missing sound effects when navigating certain menus using a controller.

[b]🔊 Audio Improvements[/b]
Search and Destroy Mode: New sounds added for key actions — including picking up and planting the bomb.

[b]Louder Pickup Feedback:[/b] Enhanced sound effects when picking up medkits, ammo, and explosives — now with clearer audio cues for better acknowledgment.

[b]UAV/Drone Perks:[/b] Activation of UAV/Drone perks now includes dedicated audio for improved battlefield feedback.

[b]🖼️ UI / Visual Updates[/b]

[b]New Loading Screen:[/b] Introduced a new loading screen featuring gameplay tips. More visuals are in the works — this is just the beginning!

Thanks for playing and helping us make Enforcers Revolt the best it can be. More updates are coming soon — stay sharp out there!
— The Enforcers Revolt Dev Team 🔧💥

notes.title: Patch Notes: 19/04/2025
notes.content:
[b]Map Changes:[/b]
Rustvail: Darkened the basic sand texture to improve visual contrast—was previously too light. Fixed✅

Shanty Town: Increased ambient lighting slightly due to overall darkness. Considering dynamic weather for future updates.Fixed✅

Bazrah: Removed the hanging carpet in the archway overlooking the bombsite to improve visibility and movement.Fixed✅

-Rain effects have been made more transparent to improve visibility during gameplay.Fixed✅
Audio Improvements:

Lowered jump sound volume slightly for better balance.Fixed✅

Sound Bug Fix: If you're experiencing no audio, try adjusting the volume sliders manually. A UI bug causes them to appear full when they’re actually muted.Fixed✅

[b]Controller/Gameplay Issues[/b]:
Controller Movement Bug: If you're unable to move using a controller, try adjusting the mouse and zoom sensitivity sliders. This is linked to the same UI slider bug as the audio.Fixed✅

[b]Matchmaking:[/b]
Extended the pre-match countdown after map voting. This should help resolve issues with players not loading in time.Fixed✅

[b]New Feature - Host Migration System:[/b]
Sessions can now continue even if the original host disconnects. The game state is transferred to another client instantly, allowing for seamless re-hosting.⚠️ Warning ⚠️ Note: This system is still in testing and may have bugs.
